document.instructions:
Scope of this onboarding Run (allowed_source_changes): only .pharness/repository.yaml, .pharness/instructions.md, and .pharness/project.yaml may be edited. Future development WorkItems will operate under a separate write scope defined by candidate_contract.writable_paths: src/** (recursive subtree of the discovered source root), tests/** (recursive subtree of the discovered test root), and README.md (exact file for the discovered documentation root). Proposing these future paths does not authorize this onboarding Run to edit them; the two scopes are distinct. The onboarding-only .pharness paths are intentionally excluded from the future development scope.

Environment: python-3.11 profile with python_hashed_requirements preparation strategy and denied lifecycle scripts. Dependencies are pinned via requirements.lock (pip_requirements, sha256 29a659d071f1d7d73e4426e1fe451e0435379bc593ee1b6ed78de15a89aa35fe); dependency_lock_generation is false, so the lock is treated as immutable. Package installation is preparation_only and agent_network is denied.

Acceptance: python -m unittest discover -s tests -v (sourced from README.md line 3). No services are requested for this qualification subject.
